targets.query:
from(bucket: "greenhouse")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "environment" and (r._field == "temperature_c" or r._field == "humidity_pct"))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field", "device_id", "actuator"])

from(bucket: "greenhouse")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "environment" and (r._field == "soil_moisture_pct"))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field", "device_id", "actuator"])

from(bucket: "greenhouse")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "environment" and (r._field == "light_lux"))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field", "device_id", "actuator"])

from(bucket: "greenhouse")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "actuator_event" and (r._field == "state"))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field", "device_id", "actuator"])
